source.description: European cities per snapshot year (all cities with a population record within -50/+25 years of the snapshot, sorted by population; cities without a record in the window but with records on both sides are kept via log-linear interpolation and flagged natureOfEstimate: "imputed" — no one-sided extrapolation), derived from the Historical Urban Population dataset (Chandler, digitized by Reba, Reitsma & Seto 2016, DOI 10.7927/H4ZG6QBX)
